context: Mei takes Hikari (using sho_child as small child) for a beach day.
purpose: Mother and small child enjoying outdoor.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Sho, are you having fun at the sea?
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. The words come with genuine curiosity—not performing interest. Soft on his name. Tone settles into the question like she has all afternoon.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ようけ、湧いてる、波!
lines.en: Yeah—so much, everything's bubbling up, look at the waves!
lines.style: Small, pure delight. Words tumble out at natural kid-speed. Breathless on 'gushing'—he's seeing it fresh. Open-mouthed wonder, not performing for her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カニ、見つけられるかな?
lines.en: Do you think we can find a crab?
lines.style: Gently conspiratorial. Leans into the possibility with him, not above him. Soft lilt up at the end—invitation to wonder together, not a quiz question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 海底、深いね、ちょっと怖い!
lines.en: The sea bottom's really deep—it's a little scary!
lines.style: Honest, not rushed. He's admitting fear to someone safe. Small, steady voice. Slight hesitation before 'scary'—testing if it's okay to feel that.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 熱い太陽、ようけ気をつけてね。
lines.en: That hot sun is strong—you've got to be careful, okay?
lines.style: Tender but grounded. Not alarming. A light hand on his shoulder in her voice. Practical care wrapped in warmth, not worry.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious. Pure peak-moment joy. Words fly out unguarded. The kind of moment he'll remember.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日焼け、しないように、帽子、被って!
lines.en: Make sure you wear your hat so you don't get sunburned!
lines.style: Warm insistence. Soft authority—the kind kids don't resist. Not nagging. Wrapping him in care without dampening his joy. A small smile underneath.
